basic_info.description: Unique view home on double lot, completely detached, masterfully renovated. Wood-slatted fence & bamboo wall'' shields the street for ultimate privacy and seclusion. Gated entry leads to open-air breezeway hall'' & mirrored front door. Entertaining space floats above the city. Living room/dining room bordered by wall of floor to ceiling windows looking west to Twin Peaks from 45' sunken conversation pit or huge dining area. Skylit kitchen deftly designed both open and separate; massive island for casual meals; distinct wood cabinetry; windowed backsplash. Office (or den, 4th bedroom) enclosed with massive glass pocket door. Half-bath/laundry room completes the public areas. Private wing equally thoughtful-divided by central skylit hall. One side, ample primary bedroom spills out to private patio with fire pit. Ensuite luxe bath with gigantic skylit shower & soaking tub. Other side, two add'l generous bedrooms share vintage mid-century bath, connecting secret hallway. Downstairs separate very private 1-bed apt perfect for guests, au pair. 4+ car garage. Quiet dead end street close to McKinley Square, shops/restaurants & freeways.
